findings.message: Chart default `configReloader.image.tag` changed from `v0.91.0@sha256:7d9e4eea5f1139e602508871f422b0116c60e87c662f3dcd234d5ab60cd0d8c1` to `v0.94.2@sha256:a1897c67478bc23434534e91ad3855280771196b1daf17144db9dbcb655bef71` and the rendered objects differ.
The pod template of DaemonSet/stageproof-check/stageproof-rel-alloy changed at spec.template.spec.containers[name=alloy].image. The pods will restart. A restart is normal for an upgrade.

findings.detail: Stageproof does not read that project's upgrade notes. A skip of more than one minor version, or a new major version, is named here and does not block.
findings.message: Chart version moves from 1.9.0 to 1.16.0, skipping 6 minor versions.

findings.detail: This is the chart's declared application version. It is not a test that the registry tag exists.
findings.message: appVersion moves from v1.16.3 to v1.22.0. The image that the chart runs may change with it.

findings.detail: The render names a different image, including images on custom resources and images passed as container arguments. Whether that tag exists is a separate check.
findings.message: 2 container images changed. DaemonSet/stageproof-check/stageproof-rel-alloy.template.spec.containers[0] alloy container moves from docker.io/grafana/alloy:v1.16.3 to docker.io/grafana/alloy:v1.22.0. DaemonSet/stageproof-check/stageproof-rel-alloy.template.spec.containers[1] config-reloader container moves from quay.io/prometheus-operator/prometheus-config-reloader:v0.91.0@sha256:7d9e4eea5f1139e602508871f422b0116c60e87c662f3dcd234d5ab60cd0d8c1 to quay.io/prometheus-operator/prometheus-config-reloader:v0.94.2@sha256:a1897c67478bc23434534e91ad3855280771196b1daf17144db9dbcb655bef71.

findings.detail: A rehearsal installs the chart into an empty cluster. It does not upgrade data that is already there. An empty-cluster result of 0 restarts does not mean an existing workload stayed up.
findings.message: This chart ships custom resource definitions, and the application it runs is changing. Custom resources that already exist on a real cluster are not in this check.
